title: Tech Note: Running a REST Server from 4D
author: Tai Bui, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: This note describes hand-rolled REST endpoints built on 4D's HTTP web server, which predates 4D's own native ORDA-based REST server (introduced with 4D v16 R6/v17). The manual request-handling, parameter parsing, and authentication patterns shown are largely superseded by 4D's built-in REST server, though the general HTTP/REST concepts explained remain accurate.
related_updates: 4D introduced a native, built-in ORDA-based REST server (v16 R6/v17+) that auto-exposes dataclasses and methods as REST endpoints, replacing much of the manual routing shown here
Modern 4D REST also supports JWT/session tokens and richer query operators ($filter, $method) beyond the custom parameter handling in this note
